  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  NOVEMBER 13, 2023

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Davis at 6:01 p.m., on
  Monday, November 13, 2023, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Gleam Davis
  Mayor Pro Tem Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Phil Brock
  Councilmember Oscar de la Torre
  Councilmember Christine Parra
  Councilmember Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 6:01 p.m., with all
  members present. Councilmember Parra led the assemblage in the Pledge
  of Allegiance.

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  Members of the public Tom Larmore, Debbie Mulvaney, Cris Gutierrez,
  CLOSED SESSION,  Natalya Zernitskaya (time donated by Anushka McCreary), Ellis Raskin,
  SPECIAL AGENDA  Ted Winterer, Joe Pertel, Sirinya Matute, Barry Snell, Chris Harding (time
  ITEMS AND CONSENT  donated by Laurie Lieberman), Dan Hall (time donated by Michael Dubin,
  CALENDAR ONLY:  and Michael Feinstein commented on closed session items.

  AGENDA  Motion by Councilmember de la Torre, seconded by Councilmember Parra,
  MANAGEMENT  to continue Item 3.A. to the 11/28 meeting to allow him time to consult
  with his Attorney’s regarding the potential conflict of interest issue. The
  vote failed by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers de la Torre, Parra, Brock
  NOES:  Councilmembers Torosis, Zwick, Mayor Pro Tem Negrete,
  Mayor Davis
  ABSENT: None

  CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 6:40 p.m., to consider
  closed sessions and returned at 8:12 p.m., with all members present, to
  report the following:

  3.A. Conference with legal counsel – existing litigation - Gov. Code
  §54956.9(d)(1): Pico Neighborhood Association and Maria Loya v. City
  of Santa Monica, L.A.S.C. Case No. BC 616804; Second District Court

  1  November 13, 2023
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 12E48DE1-0E55-4F7F-A3EE-815DC4420376

  of Appeal Case No. B295935

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  3.B. Conference with legal counsel – existing litigation and opt-out of
  class action settlement regarding PFAS contamination; Gov. Code
  §54956.9(d)(1): In re Aqueous Flim-Forming Foams Products Liability
  Litigation, No. 2:18-mn-02873-RMG (D.S.C.)

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  3.C. Conference with legal counsel – consider initiation of litigation
  regarding PFAS contamination; Gov. Code §54956.9(d)(4)

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  3.D. Conference with legal counsel - existing litigation - Gov. Code
  §54956.9(d)(1): Eric Canonico v. City of Santa Monica; LASC Case
  No. 21STCV22615 [report out only]

  The City Attorney advised the Council approved Settlement Agreement
  No. 11496 (CCS), in the amount of $397,500 previously approved by
  Council on October 10, 2023, with a unanimous vote of 7-0.

  3.E. Conference with legal counsel - existing litigation - Gov. Code
  §54956.9(d)(1): Juana Lopez-Sanchez v. City of Santa Monica et al.;
  LASC Case No. 21STCV45447 [report out only]

  The City Attorney advised the Council approved Settlement Agreement
  No. 11497 (CCS), in the amount of $ 150,000 previously approved by
  Council on May 23, 2023, unanimous vote of 7-0.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 8:13 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Gleam Davis
  City Clerk  Mayor

  2  November 13, 2023
